title: Push the last toolbar button to the end
goal: Absorb remaining space with the Flex item's automatic margins.
summary: remain close to each other, and the last "export" is placed on the other side of the toolbar.
tasks: keeps the Flex arrangement and spacing of .toolbar unchanged.
Sets automatic margins on the starting side for .export, and aligns the left and right sides of the toolbar head to tail.

example.note: spindle, the auto margin will absorb this space.

hint: Add margin-inline-start: auto to the last button to be pushed away.
